sentences.en: Scouts can start a fire using only flint and steel.
sentences.zh: 童子军可以用燧石和钢片生火。

sentences.en: Boy Scouts need to do one good deed every day.
sentences.zh: 男童子军每天需要做好事。

sentences.en: The scouts doubt that the tracks belong to a bear.
sentences.zh: 侦察员认为这些足迹不是熊留下的。
